latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — convert text scripts into free shareable videos with AI.

- Instantly turn up to 200-word blog posts or articles into 1080p MP4 videos with visuals and voiceover, for free.
- Simple setup: paste your script, describe your desired outcome, and download the result in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic credit/token system enables 100 free credits for anonymous users, valid 7 days.
- No manual editing: AI handles uploads, edits, background music, and exporting within a guided chat workflow.
- Supports direct file uploads (video, audio, images) and a clear set of user commands for editing, checking credits, and exporting.
- Error handling and session management built in for seamless user experience.
